result.description: Asseti Operations Pty Ltd  The Software Engineer is responsible for the design, development, testing, implementation and maintenance of software applications, backend systems and websites. The role requires strong technical expertise, problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that meet business objectives and user requirements.  The role involves researching, analysing and documenting system requirements, writing and maintaining code, testing and debugging applications, supporting software deployments, resolving technical issues and contributing to the ongoing improvement of software systems.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Research, analyse and document system and software requirements for various projects.  Analyse user and business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.  Design software architecture, system components, data structures and integration interfaces in accordance with functional and technical requirements.  Design, develop, modify, implement, test and maintain scalable software applications, backend systems, websites and related services in accordance with software engineering principles and business requirements.  Write clean, efficient, scalable and well-documented code to meet system requirements and technical specifications.  Test, debug and diagnose errors in application programming, ensuring adherence to established protocols and programming standards.  Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues to improve site reliability, system functionality and user experience.  Maintain and enhance existing software applications and systems.  Optimise website and application performance through efficient coding practices and database management.  Manage testing and automation of software deployments and support the release of backend systems and websites.  Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, maintainability and adherence to best practices.  Work closely with product managers, developers and operations teams to align software solutions with business requirements and resolve technical issues.  Provide input into new features and system enhancements based on user feedback.  Create and maintain technical documentation, including system designs, workflows, technical specifications and user guides.  Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the development team.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor’s degree or higher qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field. At least five years of relevant experience and/or relevant vendor certification may substitute for the formal qualification.  Proven experience designing, developing, testing, implementing and maintaining software applications and systems.  Strong knowledge of software engineering principles, methodologies and best practices.  Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, C++ or similar.  Experience working with relational and/or non-relational databases.  Understanding of software development lifecycle processes.  Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.  Strong analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment   About Company    Asseti is an AI-powered asset intelligence platform that enables enterprise property owners, infrastructure operators and government agencies to manage their physical assets through a single source of truth. The platform aggregates and analyses asset information from multiple sources, transforming complex property and infrastructure data into actionable and defensible insights. By leveraging artificial intelligence, machine learning and advanced analytics, Asseti supports evidence-based maintenance, risk and capital planning decisions, enabling customers to move from reactive, manual asset management to proactive, data-driven asset lifecycle management.      Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $80000-90000   Job Publish:  20-07-2026   Job Expire:  19-08-2026  Apply on:  Software Engineer Job here!    This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.
